           GALIUM APARINE

         Goose-Grass


Galium acts on the urinary organs, is a diuretic and of use in dropsies,
        gravel and calculi. Dysuria and cystitis. Has power of suspending or modifying cancerous
        action. Has clinical confirmation of its use in cancerous ulcers and nodulated tumors of the
        tongue. Inveterate skin affections and scurvy. Favors healthy granulations on ulcerated
        surfaces.



Dose.--  Fluid extract; half-dram doses, in cup of water or
        milk, three times a day.
